properties.name: Sibiu to Târgoviște by the Red Tower pass and the Olt
properties.via: Sibiu | Turnu Roșu (Red Tower) pass | Râmnicu Vâlcea | Curtea de Argeș | Târgoviște
properties.note: Schematic: the Olt gorge south of Sibiu, then east along the hills to the seats of Argeș and Târgoviște. The line joins named towns and the pass; it is not the road's course.
properties.citation: Editorial corridor, Stage III thin slice (TCX-86); route evidence to be added as Evidence records

properties.name: Brașov to Târgoviște by the Bran–Rucăr pass
properties.note: Schematic: the Bran–Rucăr crossing and Câmpulung, one route between Brașov and Târgoviște (the Prahova valley is another, not drawn yet). The line joins named places; it is not the road's course.
properties.citation: Editorial corridor, Stage III thin slice (TCX-86); route evidence to be added as Evidence records

properties.name: Brașov to Bacău by the Oituz pass
properties.via: Brașov | Târgu Secuiesc | Oituz pass | Onești | Bacău
properties.note: Schematic: east from Brașov across the Székely land to the Oituz pass, then down the Trotuș valley into Moldavia. The line joins named towns and the pass; it is not the road's course.

properties.name: Târgoviște to Brăila across the Wallachian plain
properties.note: Schematic: from the princely seat east across the plain to the Danube port of Brăila. With the Bran–Rucăr corridor it completes the Brașov–Târgoviște–Brăila route. The line joins named towns; it is not the road's course.
